sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri Pink Meenakari Square Kundan CZ Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent: A bridal masterpiece crafted in the finest Kashmiri tradition — this showstopper bracelet watch features soft pink meenakari square panels with pearl borders and ruby red kundan centres, flanking a heavily CZ stone-encrusted dial that dazzles from every angle. Below flows a multicolour kundan chand pendant with cascading triple ghungroo chains — dramatic, regal, and unforgettable. Made for brides, reception nights, sangeet, and every grand occasion that deserves nothing less than extraordinary.
